name: cyberprompt
description: CYBERPROMPT — advisory Claude Code prompt rewriting with pre-optimizer ASR hygiene, intent-preserving speech rules, and deterministic provenance gates.

plugins.name: cyberprompt
plugins.description: Automatic advisory prompt optimizer: a UserPromptSubmit hook sanitizes only the optimizer copy by stripping exact Whisper credit lines and collapsing runs of 3+ identical lines, then uses a headless tool-less claude -p rewrite with bounded reference-resolution context. Replacement repairs, illocutionary force, and bounded ASR repair are instruction-governed; schema, verbatim source-quote, length, and content-token retention gates fail open to the original.
